summary: Bangkok’s Fine Arts Department National Theatre presents Thai classical dance, Khon masked dance-drama, theatre and music, but attendance depends on a dated performance. The venue reopened in 2026 after renovation; no December 2026 performance was listed on its official ticketing calendar when checked.
whyGo: See traditional Thai performing arts in a major state theatre rather than a tourist-oriented dinner show.
The programme can include Khon based on the Ramakien, Thai dance, drama and music; the exact offering varies by date.
bestFor: Visitors interested in Thai performance traditions who can plan around a confirmed show.
Combining a matinee with the nearby Old City and Sanam Luang sights.
skipIf: You need a guaranteed December date or English-language performance information before committing; neither is confirmed yet.
You want a walk-in attraction with daily opening hours.
duration: Allow about 2.5 hours for the current Khon programme listed by the ticketing site, plus arrival time; other shows may differ.
cost: Recent 2026 Khon performances are listed at 100, 150, 200, 300 or 400 THB. These are observed prices, not a confirmed December tariff.
hours: There is no regular public visitor schedule shown; attend at the time printed on a specific show ticket. Current listed Khon matinees begin at 14:00.
bestTime: Choose a date only after the December programme appears. Recent performances have been weekend matinees, which pair well with nearby Old City visits.
gettingThere: At 2 Rachini Road by Sanam Luang in Phra Nakhon. It is in the historic centre rather than beside a BTS or MRT station; a taxi or ride-hail is the simplest option. Local buses serve the Sanam Luang area, but check the route on the day. Allow extra time for Old City traffic.
booking: Check the Fine Arts Department’s National Theatre ticket portal for new listings and seat availability. Recent events offered online seats and a smaller counter allocation; the official listing gives 02 224 1342 and 02 221 0171 for questions. Confirm December availability and terms directly before travelling.
accessibility: The 2026 renovation included upgraded stage, electrical, safety and sanitation systems, but the sources reviewed do not confirm step-free audience access, wheelchair seating, lifts for visitors or assistance services. Contact the theatre before booking if access requirements matter.
practicalTips: Check the venue and date carefully: the Fine Arts Department also operates National Theatres in other provinces.
The ticket listings and announcements are primarily in Thai; English-language surtitles or translation are not confirmed.
Arrive early to locate the correct entrance and collect any counter-purchased ticket.
decemberNotes: As checked on 17 October 2026, the official schedule had announced Khon dates through 29 November 2026 and did not show a December performance. Do not plan around a December show until one is posted; programming may be added later.
uncertainties: No December 2026 event, ticket price, start time or duration was confirmed on the official calendar at research time.
Performance language, surtitles and English booking support are not stated in the sources reviewed.
Visitor accessibility details and a current official public-transit guide were not found.
